calls._about: Call rules (2026-11-13, the owner 'Go' after the defensive review: the checks looked at WHICH PACKAGES a transaction calls, not which functions). Each kind of plan step may call only the functions listed for it. Check 1 (the page, sent as #kivy-calls), the server before a card goes out (pkg_watch) and the builder (router and perps-API replies) enforce this one table; a package must ALSO be in `packages`. A rule is '<group or 0x-address>::<module>::<function>'; '*' = any, a trailing '*' = starts with. Groups: 'fw' = 0x1 / 0x2, only the helpers in `fw` (any plan) or in a step's own list; 'swap' (the routers and their adapters) / 'lend' / 'oracle' / 'perps' = the ids in `groups`. Every listed package must be in exactly ONE group (2026-11-15, default deny: a package in no group is refused in every plan — it used to count as a swap program). So a new router adapter goes into packages AND groups.swap, a Suilend or NAVI upgrade into packages AND groups.lend. `never`: refused in every plan, whatever the package. `caps`: an object of the user's of that type (module::Struct) may be used only by a plan with one of those steps. Derived from real builds of every card kind and every Kivy transaction the team wallets sent since 2026-10-15 (reports: /srv/kivy).

consts._about: Values check 1 (index.html), the server (kivy/policy.py) and the builder all use; this is their ONLY copy (architecture programme change 5, 2026-11-14 — they were typed by hand in all three). route_fee_wallets: the swap routers' own fee wallets, the only addresses a coin the plan never mentions may go to during a swap. aggregator_entry: the swap aggregators' entry programs (Aftermath router, Cetus aggregator v3) — a coin only their route touches may go to any address, in a PURE swap only. perps_programs: Aftermath perps; only a perps plan may call it. pulls_value: the function-name pattern of steps that take value out of a protocol; a transaction with one is never a pure swap. A missing value makes every reader stricter (fail closed). A new aggregator entry program goes into aggregator_entry (kivy-vet-package skill).
